summary: No sell trigger or must-stay-true item was tripped today. The signals were price moves with little news: Cirrus Logic, Super Micro and Nova fell, and Leidos rose 7% despite a JPMorgan downgrade. Web searches found no confirming coverage of these moves, so each is marked unconfirmed. Carried over: Booking's FTC risk, Adobe's green-card headlines and Lululemon's leadership overhaul. Trade Desk sits at its MOS price after a 68% fall, which is the value-trap question rather than an event.

items.headline: JPMorgan cuts to Neutral, target $160 to $142; shares +7% in a day
items.why: A downgrade is fear, not business news, yet the stock rose, so the reason is unconfirmed. Check JPMorgan's stated reason (backlog or margins) before calling it EVENT or PROBLEM. Price is far above MOS $37 (METHOD 6).

items.headline: Down 7% on Citi downgrade to Neutral (target $550 to $415) in the chip sell-off
items.why: Analyst move plus a market-wide semis drop: price, not value (METHOD 7). Price $396 is far above MOS $119 and Sticker $239; the BUY* label is not an entry. Reason for the Citi cut unconfirmed.

items.headline: Fell 5% in a day and 11% in 5 days; no company news found
items.why: No filing or headline explains it; web search found nothing, so unconfirmed. Price $121 is above MOS $60 and at Sticker $120. Check for a customer-concentration report before calling it an event (event check 1).

items.headline: Fell 7% in a day; only a new board member and an 8-K item 5.02 found
items.why: No story found. Past accounting and auditor problems make any 5.02 worth reading (METHOD 4). Price $43.7 is above MOS $32.4; street mean target $42.

items.headline: Green-card (PERM) freeze headlines continue; stock +4%
items.why: Hiring and regulatory friction, not a moat breach; no dossier sell trigger (ARR growth, ROIC, net debt) is touched. Still unconfirmed for Adobe. Price $237.7 is above the first tranche at $225.

items.headline: FTC action over hotel ads still unconfirmed by the agency
items.why: Price $159 is above MOS $138. A $500M+ fine is small against FCF, but check it leaves the fee model intact (METHOD 3) and needs no debt (event check 5). No new facts since 9 Oct.

items.headline: Leadership overhaul draws mixed views (Jefferies: right direction, work remains)
items.why: No dossier trigger hit, but 'further CEO turnover' is on the list, so watch for another exit. The product fix is an event only if solvable in 1-3 years (event checks 3-4).

items.headline: Down 5% in a day and in 5 days; leadership shift at Par Pacific
items.why: Refiner margins are cyclical, so read the leadership 8-K for the reason (METHOD 4). Price $84 is above MOS $72. Cause unconfirmed.

items.headline: Up 7.5% on board changes and a new capital allocation committee
items.why: Board news filed with a material agreement (8-K 1.01). Read the agreement; no business damage found. Price $78.9 is above MOS $44.

items.headline: Down 68% this year; one writer exited on 'structural revenue deceleration'
items.why: Price $11.95 is just under MOS $12.6. This is the value-trap question (LESSONS): moat breach or solvable event? Check ad-spend share loss before any buying (event check 6). Headlines only, unconfirmed.
